[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: MAP media pipeline: intake front door + still-photo S3 fix (+ São Jorge stills migration)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/farm-media-daemon/pull/31
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/farm-media-daemon/pull/32
  
  Details:
  Thread 30550 — MAP (Media Archive Pipeline) execution work.
  
  ## Shipped (merged to TrueSightDAO/farm-media-daemon)
  - **PR #31 (Unit C, merged 72906feb)** — archive worker fix: `resolve_extensions()` now strips photo extensions so HEIC/JPG stills can never be streamed into S3 (enforces the "No S3 for still photos" rule in MEDIA_ARCHIVE_PIPELINE.md); loud WARNING when a root's `extensions` key is absent (replaces the silent `.MOV`-only default that caused the mis-route filed in OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md ~1660); ERROR when a root has no video extensions. config.yaml.example corrected. +4 tests.
  - **PR #32 (Unit A, merged 09352f5e)** — new `farm_media_intake.py` front door for `/media/to_process/`: settle-guard (never claim a still-uploading zip), sha256 dedupe against a JSON ledger (re-upload → duplicates/), free-space guard (loud refuse, exit 2), atomic `os.rename` claim into `processing/` with same-filesystem assertion; plus systemd service+timer and 10 tests. Verified with a live read-only dry-run: claimed 4 settled zips, correctly held back the one dropped mid-session, changed nothing on disk.
  
  ## São Jorge stills migration (S3 → GitHub)
  Per MAP "No S3 for still photos": uploaded the 3 gap HEICs (IMG_1626/1666/8529) to `farm-media-raw/fazenda-sao-jorge-bahia/photos/` (GitHub now 39/39), then purged the 39 `.HEIC` from S3 `raw/sao-jorge/` after asserting every object existed on GitHub first. Videos intact (73/73); manifest + farm gallery had 0 S3 refs so nothing downstream broke. Local originals sha256-verified 39/39.
  
  ## Verification
  - Unit C & Unit A each verified by clean-clone run of the exact pushed SHA: pytest 89→99 passed, ruff check + format clean, compileall OK.
  - Nothing deployed — running services still execute old copies; intake timer left inactive (governor-gated ops step).
  
  ## Notes
  - Target repo confirmed as farm-media-daemon (not truesight_autopilot) after recon found the daemon is a separate nested repo.
  - A live dry-run caught a real bug the unit tests missed (disk_usage on a not-yet-existing dir) — fixed with `_free_bytes()` + 2 regression tests.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
